classification.difficultyReason: Apply the supplied floor definition to choose the greatest integer no larger than 2.999.

content.prompt:
Let $x\in\mathbb R$ and define $\lfloor x\rfloor$ and $\lceil x\rceil$ by
$$\begin{aligned}\lfloor x\rfloor&=\max\{m\in\mathbb Z\text{ where }m\le x\}\\\lceil x\rceil&=\min\{m\in\mathbb Z\text{ where }m\ge x\}\end{aligned}$$
These are respectively called the $\mathit{floor}$ and $\mathit{ceiling}$ of $x$. Find the value of $\lfloor2.999\rfloor$.

answer.worked: $2\le2.999<3$, so the greatest integer no greater than $2.999$ is $2$. Hence $\lfloor2.999\rfloor=2$.
